T: A1 [ T ] to pronounce words or sounds, to express a thought, opinion, or suggestion, or to state a fact or instruction

I or T: B1 [ I or T ] to think or believe
B1 [ I or T ] to give (as) an opinion or suggestion about something

T: › [ T ] to show what you think without using words

T always passive: B2 [ T always passive ] When something or someone is said to be a particular thing, that is what people think or believe about it, him, or her.

T: B1 [ T ] to give information in writing, numbers, or signs

NONE: › used to express surprise or pleasure, or to attract attention to what you are about to say
（用以表示驚訝、驚喜或喚起聽話人的注意）哎呀
› (the right to give) an opinion about something
意見；決定權；發言權

example: Small children find it difficult to say long words.
小孩子覺得長字不好說。
She said goodbye to all her friends and left.
她跟所有的朋友道別後就離開了。
Ben never forgets to say "Please" and "Thank you".
班從來不忘說「請」和「謝謝」。
How do you say "goodbye" in French?
「法語裡的『再見』怎麽說？」
I'm sorry, what did you say?
對不起，你剛才說甚麽？
Do you know what she said to him?
你知道她對他說了甚麽嗎？
What did they say about the house?
關於這棟房子他們怎麽說？
[ + speech ] "I'm going out this evening," she said.
「今晚我要出去，」她說。
He said to himself (= thought), "This will never work."
他自言自語道：「這怎麼也行不通。」
[ + (that) ] The doctors say (that) it will take him a few weeks to recover.
醫生說他需要幾週時間才能康復。
[ + question word ] She didn't say whether she was coming.
她沒說她要不要來。
Did she say (= tell you) why she wasn't coming?
她有告訴你爲甚麽不來了嗎？
[ + to infinitive ] informal He said (= told me) to meet him here.
他說（叫我）在這裡和他見面。
I've got something to say to you.
我有些事要跟你講。
The offer was so good that I couldn't say no (= couldn't refuse).
這個價格太令人滿意了，我無法拒絕。
"It's going to be a very hot summer." "So they say (= that is what people believe)."
「今年夏天會很熱。」「大家都這麽說。」
She is a firm leader, too firm, some might say (= some people believe that she is too firm).
她是一個嚴格的隊長，有人可能會認爲她太嚴格了。
"Who do you think will get the job?" "I'd rather not say."
「你認爲誰會得到這份工作?」「我寧願不發表意見。」
What are you saying, exactly? (= What do you mean?)
你到底是甚麽意思？
[ + (that) ] We've been driving all day - I say (that) we start looking for a motel now.
我們已經開了一整天車——我覺得我們現在應該找一家汽車旅館了。
informal What do you say we sell the car? (= What do you think about selling it?)
你覺得我們把車賣了怎麽樣？
[ + (that) ] The look on his face said (= showed) (that) he knew what had happened.
他臉上的表情說明他知道發生了甚麽事情。
[ + (that) ] It is said (that) Latin is a difficult language to learn.
據說拉丁語是一種很難學的語言。
My watch says three o'clock.
我的錶是三點鍾。
Can you read what that sign says?
你能看見那個指示牌上寫著什麼嗎？
[ + (that) ] It says in the paper (that) they've found the man who did it.
報上說他們找到了做那件事的人。
[ + to infinitive ] It says on the bottle to take three tabletsa day.
瓶子的標籤上寫著一日服用三片。

US Say, that's really good of you!
哎呀，你真好！
US Say, how about going out tonight?
嗨，今晚出去玩吧！
UK I say, what a splendid hat you're wearing!
呀，你的帽子真漂亮！
Keep quiet for a minute and let me have my say.
你不能安靜一會兒讓我發表一下意見嗎？
The judge usually has the final say.
法官通常擁有最終的決定權。

NONE: › something that someone who is taking a photograph of you tells you to say so that your mouth makes the shape of a smile
說「茄子」（要求照相的人說 cheese 使口形呈微笑狀）
› to accept that you will not have something any more or that you will not get it
不再擁有；得不到

example: Once you have kids, you can say goodbye to going out every weekend.
一旦有了孩子，就別想每個週末外出了。

NONE: › said to show that you understand exactly what the other person is suggesting
知道了，不用再講了

example: "I saw him coming out of her flat." "Say no more!"
「我看見他從她的公寓裡出來。」「明白了，不要再說了！」

NONE: › used to tell someone that you will do what they want at the time they ask you
吩咐一下，說一聲，表示一下

example: You only have to/Just say the word, and I'll come and help.
你只要說一聲，我就會來幫忙。

NONE: › to say something good about someone or something considered to be bad
爲…說好話，爲…美言

example: I'll say this much for Kay, she always agrees to help whenever we ask her.
我要幫凱說幾句好話，只要我們提出來，她總是願意伸出援手。

NONE: › to admit failure
承認失敗，認輸
› said when you are pouring a drink for someone and you want them to tell you when to stop pouring
（為人倒酒時跟對方說的話）斟夠了請說一聲
› to say what you are obviously wanting to say
直抒胸臆，直言不諱

example: Just say your piece and then go.
只管說你想說的話，說完就離開。

S: › an instruction to do something, or permission given by someone to do something
› a statement made by someone without proof
隨便說說，無根據的斷言

example: She's not allowed to do anything without her father's say-so.
沒有她父親的允許她什麼也不能做。
Don't just believe it on my say-so - find out for yourself.
我只是隨口說說，不要當真——你得自己去弄個明白。

NONE: C1 a well-known wise statement that often has a meaning that is different from the simple meanings of the words it contains
格言，警句，諺語

example: As the saying goes, "Don't count your chickens before they're hatched."
正如俗語所說：「別太早打如意算盤。」

NONE: › to show what a particular person or thing is like
說明，表明（某人或某物的個性特質、真正面貌）

example: The way he drives says a lot about his character.
從他開車的方式很容易就看出他的性格。

NONE: › informal used when you are arguing with someone, to show that you do not accept or agree with what they say
（在爭執時表示不同意或不接受對方的說法）誰說的？

example: You're the best? Says who?
「你最好？誰說的？」
